items.title: Butch Miles interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 9, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]

ctx.x: But I like doing something like you just said, “Okay let’s take Weather Report and ‘Birdland’ and then let’s take Buddy Rich’s big band and ‘Birdland.’” And you listen to the difference of what Peter Erskine, my old buddy Peter Erskine is doing when he’s

playing with Weather Report as compared to what Buddy did with his own band. When they get to a certain section of “Birdland” Buddy is wailing away and the walls and peeling paint, everything’s on fire all around him and he’s just going like a rocket blast. Whereas when they get to the same type of section on Weather Report Peter shifts into a shuffle rhythm. He doesn’t continue over that straight ahead eighth notes and straight ahead sixteenth. He goes into a shuffle with a big backbeat and you compare both…
